notes: Structural: Body screen split into a hub + 10 dedicated LogScreens (Sleep / Exercise / MentalLoad / Symptom / Somatic / Substance / Cycle / Medication / Agpeya / SocialMedia). Tap a row on the Body hub to open the dedicated entry screen. Combined with v0.3.0 (toggles moved to Settings), the Body surface now matches spec section 633-642 exactly: Settings = config, Body hub = nav, LogScreens = data entry.
